description: This file defines the API for a storage module in the Starboard platform, including functions for opening, closing, reading, writing, and deleting storage records, as well as handling storage record validity and version-specific behavior.

methods.name: SbStorageOpenRecord
methods.description: Opens and returns a storage record, with behavior depending on API version and parameters.

methods.name: SbStorageCloseRecord
methods.description: Closes a storage record, ensuring data is flushed.

methods.name: SbStorageGetRecordSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a storage record.

methods.name: SbStorageReadRecord
methods.description: Reads data from a storage record into a buffer.

methods.name: SbStorageWriteRecord
methods.description: Writes data to a storage record, replacing existing data.

methods.name: SbStorageIsValidRecord
methods.description: Checks if a storage record handle is valid.
